title: Concept-Guided Prompting Strategies Increase Diversity in LLM-Generated Recipe Populations
abstract: arXiv:2611.01171v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Novelty in solution generation supports automated discovery, but LLM outputs can remain repetitive. To address this, we propose a simple concept-guided prompting method that generates thematic concepts before responses within each of these concepts. To demonstrate, we generated 1,000 recipes for a recipe book task and compared the results against a human-authored corpus. Two naive prompting strategies were compared as baselines. Concept-guided prompting outperformed both baselines in all cases and reached semantic coverage of 47.0% versus 35.1% and 13.1% in respective prior-title and nonce prompt strategies. These findings suggest broader population exploration and diversity, but remain contained to this specific task. Further work is needed to determine the quality of solutions and generalizability.

translated_title: 概念引导的提示策略提升大语言模型生成食谱种群的多样性
translated_abstract: 解决方案生成中的新颖性能够支持自动化发现，但大语言模型的输出往往仍然重复。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种简单的概念引导提示方法，该方法先在各主题概念内生成响应，再进行输出。作为演示，我们为一个食谱书任务生成了1,000个食谱，并将结果与人工编写的语料库进行比较。两种朴素的提示策略被作为基线进行比较。概念引导提示在所有情况下均优于两个基线，达到了47.0%的语义覆盖率，而先验标题提示策略和随机提示策略分别仅为35.1%和13.1%。这些发现表明该方法能够实现更广泛的种群探索和多样性，但仍局限于这一特定任务。需要进一步的研究来确定解决方案的质量和泛化能力。
tldr: 提出一种概念引导的提示方法，在食谱生成任务中将语义覆盖率从基线的35.1%和13.1%提升至47.0%，显著增强了大语言模型生成结果的多样性。
en_tdlr: A simple concept-guided prompting method that generates thematic concepts before responses boosts semantic coverage to 47.0% compared to 35.1% and 13.1% for baseline strategies, significantly increasing diversity in LLM-generated recipe populations.
